title: Mom's Chicken Soup
description: A comforting, hearty chicken soup that's perfect for cold days or when you're feeling under the weather. Made with love and fresh vegetables.
ingredients: 1 whole chicken (about 4 lbs) or 2 lbs chicken pieces
instructions: Place the chicken in a large pot and cover with water. Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce to a simmer.
Skim off any foam that rises to the surface. Add the bay leaves, thyme, and parsley. Simmer for 30-40 minutes until the chicken is cooked through.
Remove the chicken from the pot and set aside to cool. Keep the broth simmering.
Add the onion, carrots, celery, and garlic to the broth. Simmer for 15 minutes until vegetables are tender.
While the vegetables cook, shred the chicken meat, discarding the skin and bones.
Add the egg noodles to the soup and cook according to package directions, usually about 8 minutes.
Return the shredded chicken to the pot. Season generously with salt and pepper.
Remove the bay leaves. Ladle into bowls and garnish with fresh dill if desired.
notes: This soup tastes even better the next day after the flavors have had time to meld. You can substitute the egg noodles with rice or leave them out entirely for a lighter soup. Freeze in portions for up to 3 months.
